🚐✨ What a great day at Logitech Work on Wheels!✨🚐

Last week, we had the pleasure of hosting the Logitech Work on Wheels experience at our TD SYNNEX office in Mississauga, bringing together 70+ attendees from our sales teams and reseller partners. 🙌

It was amazing to see everyone experiencing Logitech and Microsoft solutions firsthand and watching their reactions to the incredible Digital Cocoon technology. 🤯🚀

A huge thank you to Wendy Cockburn and Timothy Oh for the flawless organization, Paikan Schouten for crossing the border and delivering an incredible (as always) live presentation 🎤👏, and the entire Logitech team Luke Heaslip, Mona Bhadauria, John Szemeczko, Matthew Tjoa, Effie Rezkalla and Jenny Xu for their support and partnership throughout the event. 🤝

☕The only disappointment? It seems everyone was so impressed by the technology that they missed my presentation on Colombian coffee! 😂 Fortunately, I'm always available to discuss both collaboration solutions and great coffee.

Looking forward to many more opportunities to learn, collaborate, and innovate together! 🚀
